rationale: Motor vehicle collision with documented damage to the policyholder's vehicle and injury to the driver caused by another vehicle.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was totaled in a rear-end collision on Route 9 at 8:15am yesterday when hit by a vehicle at approximately 35 mph. Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. The other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report. Vehicle damage is severe with total loss expected; medical evaluation and coordination with other carrier are needed.

case_facts.description: rear-ended at red light by vehicle traveling 35 mph, other driver did not brake
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled, entire trunk crushed into back seat
